column20: What went wrong and why? A planned change updated the accepted certificates used for Software Load Balancer node connection authorization
column21: What went wrong and why? loss of connectivity between nodes and resources inside the region
column22: What went wrong and why? a region-specific configuration deployed in the region; What happened? resources hosted in the Switzerland North region
column23: What happened? service availability issues for resources hosted in the Switzerland North region
column25: How did we respond? The configuration was successfully reverted and most resources were automatically restored
column26: What went wrong and why? a region-specific configuration carried that certificate through a deployment pipeline/process that was not covered by our standard deployment health checks
column27: How can customers make incidents like this less impactful? customers should consider a multi-region geodiversity strategy to avoid impact from incidents like this one that impacted a single region
column28: Config revert restored most resources but residual VM-extension impact needed manual mitigation scripts and full recovery took ~22h.
